test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

John rushed to the spot and saw his wife and kid ________ on the road.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2 i.e. (lying)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct verb to use in this context is "lying" as it refers to being in or assuming a horizontal or resting position on a surface. 
 
• "Lying" is the present participle of the verb "to lie."
 
• Therefore, the sentence should read, "John rushed to the spot and saw his wife and kid lying on the road."
 
• This makes Option 2 (lying) the correct choice to fill the blank.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: "John rushed to the spot and saw his wife and kid lying on the road."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "lain" - This is the past participle form of the verb "to lie" but is not suitable in this context.
 
• "lie" - This is the base form of the verb, not correct in this sentence's tense structure.
 
• "laying" - This form of the verb typically requires an object, e.g., 'laying the blanket on the bed', and is not correct here.
